Answer key at the back and a QR code in each unit to free online practice.

about.en: The 1,000 words that come up most often in our TOPIK II practice material, 20 per unit in 50 units, from level 3 to level 6. Each unit has 20 words with part of speech, an English meaning, an example sentence with translation, a level mark (cheese) and a frequency mark (potato). Then you write the meaning, write the Korean word and write your own sentence, finish with a unit checkup, and mark your work with the answer key at the back. A QR code opens a free match game for the same 20 words. Look-alike words (synonyms and sound-alikes) are explained at the end of each unit.
